message.content:
This editorial illustration features a large, stylized orange background with a red vertical stripe on the left. At the top, the large black word "TEMPO" is positioned above the handwritten text "50 Tahun!". Below this, the white headline "NAKHODA BARU KADIN" is followed by a paragraph in white Indonesian text.

The central image depicts a large, light blue building with a saw-tooth roof and a tall chimney on the left. The building's facade features a row of dark vertical columns. In front of the building, eleven men wearing dark suits stand on a reddish-orange ground. They are illustrated in a minimalist, stocky style with simplified features. Some men are standing in a small cluster, with one man in the center gesturing with his hands. Others walk toward or away from the group. Long, dark shadows stretch behind each figure.

At the top left, the words "SALING INTIP KURSI PANGLIMA TNI" appear, separated by a white slash from "RUGI TRILIUNAN PAJAK IMPOR EMAS" on the right. The bottom-left corner contains publication details, a barcode, and a QR code.
